name: Microservice Incident Response
story: A production incident has affected the Customer Management Platform. Your task is to restore the system by checking service health, identifying service responsibilities, and fixing a missing configuration value.

evidence.title: Service Dependency Map
evidence.content: Browser -> API Gateway -> Order Service -> Inventory Service

evidence.title: Order API Response
evidence.content:
POST /api/orders returns HTTP 500.
Error: Unable to complete order.
Failure occurs when Order Service calls Inventory Service.

evidence.title: Order Service Logs
evidence.content:
INFO Received order request for productId=45
INFO Calling Inventory Service
ERROR Connection failed while calling inventory endpoint

actions.text: Increase memory limit for Order Service
Update the Inventory Service path to /api/inventory/check

hints: Compare the Order Service configuration with the Inventory API documentation. Look carefully at the endpoint path.
rootCause: Order Service called /invent, but Inventory Service exposes /api/inventory/check.
learningPoint: Healthy microservices can still fail when API contracts or configured endpoint paths do not match.
